execution: Declarative fixtures. Results of actual runs are in docs/balance/evidence/. A fixture is not a result.

scenarios.title: A match starts with five players in Room B and the other 4 in Room A
scenarios.note: The fullest start the rule allows with 9 players, and with nine the only split there is. The engine takes recorded rooms; drawing them is the service's work (CAP-30).

scenarios.title: A match starts with five players in Room A and the other 4 in Room B
scenarios.note: The fullest start the rule allows with 9 players, and with nine the only split there is. The engine takes recorded rooms; drawing them is the service's work (CAP-30).

scenarios.title: A match does not start with six players in Room A
scenarios.note: The rule holds at any time, the first moment included, so no match under it begins with six players in a room. That the engine refuses such a start is how that is checked here; the six decided cases do not say which part of the system has to refuse.

scenarios.title: A match does not start with six players in Room B
scenarios.note: The rule holds at any time, the first moment included, so no match under it begins with six players in a room. That the engine refuses such a start is how that is checked here; the six decided cases do not say which part of the system has to refuse.

scenarios.title: A full room is offered to nobody; the other room is offered as before
scenarios.note: Room B holds five. With 9 players Room A holds 4, so it has a place for anyone from Room B.

scenarios.title: A move into a full room is refused, shows nobody anything and does not use the round's move
A place that a player leaves can be taken at once, also by a player who was refused before
scenarios.note: With nine players the one free place changes rooms with every move: after Hacker's move Room A is the full room, until Alien leaves it.

scenarios.title: Of two moves for the last place, the first to arrive is accepted and the second is refused
scenarios.note: Room B holds four and Room A 5. The two moves are sent one after the other, Insider's first. That the service keeps the order in which two phones' moves arrive is CAP-32.

scenarios.title: A player outside a full room can neither enter it nor act on anyone in it
scenarios.note: Capacity adds no exception to the same-location rule. What it adds is that the five inside cannot be joined, so nobody outside can reach them until one of them leaves.

scenarios.title: An Eliminated player keeps their place: the room stays full
scenarios.note: Two attacks on one Healthy player in Round 1: both Disablers.

scenarios.title: An Injured player is in Hospital from the end of the round, and their place in the room is free
A healed player returns to their last room when it has a place
scenarios.note: Cracker heals from Room A without moving (R-ROLE-04). Nobody took the place, so the last room is not full and the rule of the other room does not apply.

scenarios.title: A healed player whose last room is full goes to the other room
A released player returns to their last room when it has a place
A released player whose last room is full goes to the other room
Electing a Captain frees their place, and Command Room is never refused to its Captain
A Captain leaving Command Room is offered only a room with a place, and keeps the move if refused
A Captain voted into Jail from Command Room and released later goes to the other room when their last room is full
scenarios.note: The last room is the room the Captain was elected from. Their place there was taken while they were in Command Room.

scenarios.title: Five Jail votes in five rounds fill the Jail, and there is no sixth vote
scenarios.note: One player is sent each round: Undercover, Hacker, Red Disabler, Alien, Insider. Every Red player is among them, so Blue has the greater Power at the Round 5 check and the match ends there with the five still in Jail.

scenarios.title: The Final Zone holds all 9 players: it is not a room
scenarios.note: Power is equal at the Round 5 check, so the showdown begins: Insider is Injured and Cracker and Supplier are Jailed.

scenarios.title: Six players Injured by the end of Round 4: five are in Hospital, the sixth waits where they are, and no patient loses a place
scenarios.note: Every damage a nine-player match has before the showdown falls on a different player and nobody is healed. The three patients of Round 1 keep their places, the one with the highest number among them. Who of the three hurt in Round 4 waits is case 24.

scenarios.title: Five players Injured after a Rescue in the same round: all five are in Hospital and nobody waits, whatever the healed player's number
scenarios.note: Three patients, of whom player 9 is healed in Round 4, and players 2, 4 and 7 hurt in Round 4. Five players are Injured afterwards, so there is no sixth and nobody waits: the place the healed player leaves is free in that resolution. An engine that placed everyone in one pass by player number would reach player 7 before player 9 had left, and leave player 7 waiting.

scenarios.title: A prisoner released while Injured does not become a sixth player in Hospital
scenarios.note: Insider is Injured and Jailed, and five other players are in Hospital. The release is the Captain's to ask for and the table's to grant as before. Where Insider is then placed is case 26; this case asserts only that Hospital still holds five.

scenarios.title: When more players are hurt in one round than Hospital has places, the lower player numbers get them
scenarios.note: Players 2 (Supplier), 4 (Officer) and 7 (Red Disabler) are hurt in Round 4 and Hospital has two places, so Red Disabler waits. Red Disabler was the first of the three to be attacked and Officer the last, and Officer has the last turn of that round, so an order by attack or by turn would leave Officer waiting. Player 9 is a patient and keeps the place: an order by number over patients and newcomers alike would put player 9 out. Blocked on CAP-D1 until Backend's record of the owner's choice (CAP-ORDER-01) was read.

scenarios.title: Whether a healed player returns to a last room that a room-mate is leaving for Hospital in the same resolution
scenarios.note: Room B holds five when Round 4 resolves: Supplier is hurt and leaves it for Hospital, and Insider is healed and comes back from Hospital. Room B is full before the resolution and has a place after it.

scenarios.title: A prisoner released while Injured, with Hospital full, stays in Jail as a free player
scenarios.note: R-STATE-07 sends a prisoner released while Injured to Hospital, and Hospital holds five. Backend's record (CAPACITY-04) applies the owner's words for a player refused by Hospital, who stays where they are: the released player is free and still stands in Jail, and may be voted for again. No place comes free, so they are still there when the match ends at the Round 5 check. Blocked on CAP-D3 until that record was read.

scenarios.title: Which room is a player's last room after they were sent to the other one
scenarios.note: Supplier is released while Room B, their last room, is full, and is sent to Room A. Later Supplier is hurt in Room A and healed, and by then both rooms have a place. R-STATE-08 says the last room they occupied; the implementation remembers the room of their last move of their own.

scenarios.title: A Captain hurt after entering Command Room goes to Hospital and holds no place in a room: a healed player returns to their last room
scenarios.note: Room B, Insider's last room, holds four players before Round 3 resolves and four after it. The Captain is hurt inside Command Room and goes to Hospital like any Injured player (R-CAPT-14); the rules give no moment at which they are in Room B. An engine that sets the hurt Captain down in their last room on the way would make it five for that moment and turn the healed player away.

scenarios.title: A Captain hurt and healed in one round after entering Command Room is Captain no more and returns to their last room
scenarios.note: The sixth decided case names "a Captain who loses the title". This is how one reaches a room at once: the attack resolves before the Rescue (R-RES-01), the title is lost on the injury and does not come back with the healing, and a player who is no longer Captain and is Healthy returns to their last room (R-CAPT-14).

scenarios.title: Starting rooms are drawn by the service: never six in a room, and unrelated to role, character, faction and seat with 9 players
scenarios.note: Many lobbies of 9 players: no room starts with more than five; each seat is in Room A about half the time; the room does not follow from the character chosen, from the order of joining or from the role dealt afterwards. Not an engine run. The engine binding of this suite reaches the pure engine only; this needs the service, a device or people.

scenarios.title: A lobby whose rooms were drawn before the rule and put six players in one room
scenarios.note: Such a lobby either starts under the ruleset it was prepared for, or is given rooms the rule allows. It must not start under this ruleset with six in a room, and it must not be left unable to start. Not an engine run. The engine binding of this suite reaches the pure engine only; this needs the service, a device or people.

scenarios.title: Two phones move for the last place at the same moment
scenarios.note: The service accepts exactly one and refuses the other, whatever the timing, and a retry of the refused one is refused again while the room is full. Not an engine run. The engine binding of this suite reaches the pure engine only; this needs the service, a device or people.

scenarios.title: A match that began before the rule plays on under its own ruleset, and its replay is unchanged
scenarios.note: A running match of an earlier ruleset still lets a sixth player into a room after the new engine is deployed, and a recorded match replays to the same end state. Not an engine run. The engine binding of this suite reaches the pure engine only; this needs the service, a device or people.

scenarios.title: What a refused mover is shown, and what the table sees
scenarios.note: The phone does not show the full room as a destination. If a move is refused because the place was taken a moment before, the mover is told plainly and the table sees nothing. Not an engine run. The engine binding of this suite reaches the pure engine only; this needs the service, a device or people.

scenarios.title: A Captain who loses the title inside Command Room and whose last room is full goes to the other room
scenarios.note: As case 29, and two players enter Room B after the Captain has left it for Command Room.

scenarios.title: A player who waits goes to Hospital at the end of the next round, when a place has come free
scenarios.note: Red Disabler waits through Round 5. Cracker heals a patient in Round 5, so a place is free when the round resolves. The match ends at the Round 5 check with a Blue win, which leaves every player where the resolution put them.

scenarios.title: A player who waits in a room can be healed by a Cracker in that room, and not from the other room
scenarios.note: Cracker reaches into Hospital from either room (R-ROLE-04), and a waiting player is not in Hospital. Red Disabler waits in Room A; Cracker is in Room B, cannot name them, moves to Room A and can. With Red Disabler healed, Power is equal at the Round 5 check and the showdown begins.

scenarios.title: The released prisoner who stands in Jail goes to Hospital at the end of the round, when a place has come free
scenarios.note: After the release the table votes a patient, Hacker, into Jail. That frees a place before the round resolves, and the released player, who is free and Injured and stands in Jail, takes it.

scenarios.title: An Eliminated player's place counts against a returning player too: the released player goes to the other room
scenarios.note: Room B, the released player's last room, holds four living players and one Eliminated. That is five.

scenarios.title: A full room cannot be entered during a Hack conversation or while a Captain is elected
scenarios.note: A move may be made at any moment before voting begins, and those moments include a Hack conversation. Whether a player may move at all while a Captain is elected is not decided (D16); a move into a full room is refused under either answer.

scenarios.title: A released player and a healed player want the same last place in one round: the release comes first
scenarios.note: Room B holds four, and two absent players have it as their last room: Supplier in Jail and Insider in Hospital. A release takes effect when its vote closes (R-VOTE-10), before the round resolves, so Supplier has the place when Insider is healed.

scenarios.title: Where a Captain lies who is Eliminated after entering Command Room
scenarios.note: Two attacks are registered on the Captain in Room B, who then enters Command Room. An Eliminated player keeps their place (the second decided case), and Command Room is for the Captain. Wherever the player is put, they take one of that room's five places for the rest of the match.

steps.label: health of the Captain who was hit twice

scenarios.title: Where a Captain waits who is the sixth Injured player and was hurt after entering Command Room
scenarios.note: Red Disabler is Captain, is shot in Room A, then enters Command Room. Of the three hurt in Round 4 they have the highest number and get no place. The third decided case says a player without a place stays where they are, and a player who is no longer Captain cannot stay in Command Room.
